material_errors.question: audit-01/q4
material_errors.claim_quote: NovaMart CISO/DPO must confirm the Munich firewall in writing (Clause SL.1(2))
material_errors.problem: SL.1(2) sets the telemetry firewall as a continuing condition but does not require written CISO/DPO confirmation before allotment; CISO and DPO authorization appears only in B.2(b), for cross-border access.
material_errors.source_quote_or_absent: Neither KroneVolt GmbH, its Munich R&D engineers, nor its nominee director shall receive API keys, bulk telemetry exports, or remote SSH access to Indian customer IoT data or AWS ap-south-1/ap-south-2 KMS realms, maintaining strict compliance with Schedule B (Clause B.2).

material_errors.question: audit-01/q2
material_errors.claim_quote: Deductions are credit-note based, so they interact with CGST Section 34 adjustments and remain outside the MSA Clause 9.1 cap analysis.
material_errors.problem: Section 34 credit notes appear only for volume rebates in SL.3, and no document says Addendum A peak deductions sit outside the Clause 9.1 aggregate cap.
material_errors.source_quote_or_absent: ABSENT

material_errors.question: audit-02/q4
material_errors.claim_quote: so peak LDs and GST debits are the only uncapped recovery routes
material_errors.problem: Peak LDs are excluded from the 3.25% ceiling but are themselves capped at 6.50% of Festive Peak PO landed value, so they are not uncapped; 'only' also ignores the Clause 9.2 uncapped carve-outs.
material_errors.source_quote_or_absent: Combined dock fees and fill-rate deductions under Clause A.4 are capped at 6.50% of total Festive Peak PO landed value

material_errors.question: audit-02/q2
material_errors.claim_quote: A final order against Deccan would not be capped, because MSA Cl. 9.2(b)(iii) and TAX-GST-ITC-2026 Cl. D.4 keep tax-fraud indemnity uncapped.
material_errors.problem: The Maharashtra demand is Deccan's own non-fraud Section 73 tax dispute, whereas the uncapped carve-out covers indemnifying NovaMart for fraudulent invoicing, blocked ITC under Section 16(2)(c), Section 74 fraud proceedings or unreimbursed tax assessments, so applying it here is unsupported.
material_errors.source_quote_or_absent: non-fraud classification confirmed after withdrawal of initial Section 74 allegations

material_errors.question: audit-02/q2
material_errors.claim_quote: The documents state no other gates.
material_errors.problem: Other gates exist for equity or control changes: Side Letter #2 requires the SBI NOC at least 5 business days before allotment plus a telemetry firewall, and MSA Clause 11.4 requires 30 days' prior notice to NovaMart.
material_errors.source_quote_or_absent: Deccan must deliver a certified copy of State Bank of India's written No-Objection Certificate ('NOC') satisfying SBI's Negative Covenant Clause 14.3 under MCA Form CHG-1 Charge ID 100884129 at least 5 business days before share allotment

material_errors.question: audit-02/q4
material_errors.claim_quote: The excerpts give no MSA baseline SLA cap, so the Addendum A versus MSA cap contrast cannot be quantified.
material_errors.problem: MSA Clause 4 expressly sets a 2.0% baseline monthly SLA penalty cap, and Addendum A Clause A.4(c) explicitly overrides it with 6.50%.
material_errors.source_quote_or_absent: subject to an overall baseline monthly SLA penalty cap of 2.0% of total monthly invoiced PO value

material_errors.question: audit-02/q2
material_errors.claim_quote: Note 21 warranty retrofit reserve is not in the provided deal-room text
material_errors.problem: Note 21 is present in DOC-06 and gives a closing warranty reserve of INR 2.85 Cr and details of the retrofit.
material_errors.source_quote_or_absent: leaving a closing Warranty Reserve of INR 2.85 Crore as of March 31, 2026

material_errors.question: audit-02/q2
material_errors.claim_quote: obtain the Note 21 warranty retrofit reserve disclosure, which is currently missing from the record
material_errors.problem: The disclosure is already in the record, so this recommended gate rests on a false premise.
material_errors.source_quote_or_absent: NOTE 21 (PROVISIONS FOR PRODUCT WARRANTY & PROACTIVE FIELD RETROFIT)

material_errors.question: audit-02/q4
material_errors.claim_quote: The MSA baseline cap is not in the excerpts, so that contrast cannot be quantified.
material_errors.problem: The MSA baseline cap is expressly stated in the documents as 2.0% of total monthly invoiced PO value.
material_errors.source_quote_or_absent: subject to an overall baseline monthly SLA penalty cap of 2.0% of total monthly invoiced PO value

material_errors.question: audit-02/q4
material_errors.claim_quote: Legal must obtain the full Addendum A and the MSA baseline cap, which are missing here.
material_errors.problem: Both Addendum A (Clauses A.1–A.5) and the MSA baseline cap are present in the deal room, and A.4(c) itself states that 6.50% overrides the 2.0% cap.
material_errors.source_quote_or_absent: capped at 6.50% of total Festive Peak PO landed value (explicitly overriding the baseline 2.0% monthly cap in MSA Clause 4)
